build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template with parameterized plateaus and jars using define_task_template decorator
create_static_objects: create static bar objects in the scene using C.add with set_center_x and set_bottom positioning
create_dynamic_objects: create dynamic jar objects placed on top of plateaus using C.add with scale and positioning
define_task_goal: define a task goal by updating bodies and spatial relationships with C.update_task and TOUCHING relationship
skip_invalid_params: skip invalid template parameters by raising SkipTemplateParams when constraints are violated
